run_hot3d_processing: run the HOT3D dataset processor to extract hand and object trajectories for a given sequence
convert_glb_to_obj: convert a GLB mesh file from HOT3D into an OBJ file for downstream visualization
extract_hand_data_from_hot3d: extract MANO wrist poses and fingertip trajectories from HOT3D hand data dictionaries
build_trajectory_from_hot3d_provider: build an aligned trajectory of hand and object poses using the HOT3D data provider
process_object_sequence: process a single HOT3D object sequence and save hand object trajectories as NPZ files
